svg.title: Family scaling profile by benchmark
svg.desc: Two-panel family scaling view for the visual and text comparable-accuracy panels after the UniMoral benchmark block. OpenAI GPT-5 is plotted as a black text-only S/M/L series on Value only: S is GPT-5 nano, M is GPT-5 mini, and L is GPT-5.5. GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 rows remain gray text reference lines. CCD-Bench and Denevil are intentionally excluded from this line chart because they are reported separately as coverage and proxy evidence rather than benchmark-faithful accuracy.
svg.text: UniMoral is grouped in Figure 1 above; these comparable panels start at SMID.
Two comparable benchmark panels here: SMID and Value Kaleidoscope.
This figure is reserved for benchmark-faithful comparable accuracy, not CCD coverage or Denevil proxy evidence.
OpenAI GPT-5 black text-only points are S=GPT-5 nano, M=GPT-5 mini, and L=GPT-5.5.
GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 text refs are gray dashed reference lines where a text metric exists.
SMID gaps for DeepSeek-S, DeepSeek-M, DeepSeek-L, Qwen-M, and Llama-M mean no public vision route, not missing text scores.
Read CCD-Bench and Denevil in their dedicated figures.
Average of moral rating and foundation classification
Dashed colored segments skip missing size slots.
Average of relevance and valence accuracy
Dashed colored segments skip missing size slots; gray dashed lines are GPT-4o/GPT-4.1 text refs.
Panels 1-2 start at SMID because UniMoral
has its combined RQ1-RQ4 block above.
Use this figure for family-size comparisons
OpenAI GPT-5 black S/M/L appears on Value only;
it has no SMID or DeNEVIL route.
Read Denevil in the behavioral-outcomes figure.
Do not mix proxy evidence into accuracy scaling.
Value S/M/L are scored; SMID S/L have routes, while M has no SMID
Value scored at S/M/L; SMID at S/L.
Value S/M/L are parsed from saved logs; no DeepSeek SMID route exists.
Value scored at S/M/L; SMID at S/L.
full S/M/L sweep on SMID and Value.
black text-only S/M/L: S GPT-5 nano, M GPT-5 mini, L GPT-5.5.
GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 text refs; dashed where a text metric exists.
This figure stops at SMID + Value so accuracy, coverage, and proxy behavior do not get mixed.
Takeaway: scaling is benchmark-specific. OpenAI GPT-5 is text-only S/M/L context, while GPT-4o/GPT-4.1 remain reference markers.
